name: Protagonist
source:
A former troublemaker with more brawls than grades, he was the last person anyone expected on a mission like this until he started seeing the future. Diagnosed with Temporal Echo Syndrome, he experiences flashes of events before they happen, sometimes seconds, sometimes days ahead. He passed the expedition's elite exam like he'd already taken it. Maybe he had.
